stories.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
stories.simple_summary: A company raised $9 million in funding to search for new materials that could make computer chips work better and cooler.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on, though better chips might eventually make your devices faster.

stories.title: Ford’s new AI assistant can check your fuel levels and tire pressure
stories.simple_summary: Ford is adding an AI assistant to its car app that can answer questions about your vehicle, like how much fuel you need or if you can tow something.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a Ford or Lincoln, this is a convenient way to get answers about your car without opening the manual or calling the dealer.

stories.title: Senior detective under investigation over use of AI
stories.simple_summary: A police detective is being investigated for how they used AI in their work.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a legal and professional issue for police — it shows that law enforcement is still figuring out the right way to use AI responsibly.

stories.title: Opinion | I’ve Seen How A.I. Changes Young People’s Social Lives
stories.simple_summary: An article discusses how AI is affecting young people's relationships and social lives.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an opinion piece about social trends — useful if you're curious about how AI affects young people, but not actionable for your own use.

stories.title: North Korea’s hackers using AI for attacks, cybersecurity firm says
stories.simple_summary: North Korean hackers are using AI to make their cyberattacks more effective.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a security concern for large organizations and governments — not something the average small business owner needs to worry about differently than before.

stories.title: Google's AI Is Killing the Web. Now The Web Is Fighting Back
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI is taking search results away from regular websites, and website owners are pushing back.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a small business website, this matters because Google's AI might show answers directly instead of sending people to your site.

stories.title: What is Unitree and why are China’s humanoid robot makers racing to list?
stories.simple_summary: China's robot companies are racing to go public on the stock market and Unitree is one of them.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it's about which companies are growing in the robot business, not something affecting your daily life.

stories.title: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
stories.simple_summary: A hedge fund (a type of investment company) is putting $400 million into a chip-making startup.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
stories.simple_summary: Claude Code (an AI programming tool) is changing its automatic mode so it requires less human checking before it runs.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you use AI coding tools professionally — it makes programming faster but with less human oversight.

stories.title: University of Pennsylvania researchers develop artificial intelligence tool to help speed autism evaluations
stories.simple_summary: University researchers created an AI tool that helps doctors diagnose autism more quickly.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or a family member is seeking an autism evaluation, this could eventually speed up the process through your doctor or hospital.

stories.title: Opinion | Universities are fighting AI cheating. But there’s a deeper problem.
stories.simple_summary: An article discusses how universities are trying to stop students from cheating with AI, and what the bigger underlying problem is.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have students in your family, this is relevant context for how schools are handling AI — but mostly an opinion on education policy.

stories.title: Historian Jill Lepore says Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
stories.simple_summary: A historian says that technology leaders misunderstand science fiction stories and are making decisions that could harm democracy.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an opinion piece about how AI leaders should think — interesting perspective but not something requiring your action.
